title: Zyphers Textures!
description: Originally I made this because of my YSM (Yes Steve Models) character, and I have finally come back around to update more textures!
body:
# This is a basic texturepack I will be adding new items to every so often!

**Hey there, I'm Zypher, or Mako!**

Not everything is based off the YSM character. But I do LOVE the textures, I did not change them too much. I try to keep them vanilla friendly!

**ALOT OF TEXTURES ARE CHANGED! LISTING THEM ALL WOULD TAKE TOO MUCH SPACE!**

Mod Supported Textures:
Amendments.
(More eventually)


All textures and future textures are simply made for fun. Thank you for checking out my creation.
